<function name="SetExpanded" parent="DTree" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
<internal></internal>

Does nothing. Is not called by the <page>DTree</page> itself.

Used as a placeholder empty function alongside <page>DTree:ExpandTo</page>, <page>DTree:MoveChildTo</page> and <page>DTree:ChildExpanded</page> to prevent errors when <page>DTree_Node:SetExpanded</page> is incorrectly used on a <page>DTree</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="bExpand" type="boolean"></arg>
	</args>
</function>
